dogecoin.text: @BillyM2k People are being ridiculous and also can't take a joke. @elonmusk was joking when he said #doge is a hustle. This is people getting their hopes up and then needing someone to blame because they're disappointed. #dogecoin will come up. Relax and have fun.

@elonmusk Guys, blaming @elonmusk for #dogecoin is ridiculous just because it dipped. It'll go back up. He called it a hustle because it's a joke! For reference, jokes are something that existed pre-2014. Elon was backing #doge in 2019 before anyone was even in the train. Relax.
